packages.title: Scope, evidence and dependency freeze
packages.objective: Freeze the Step 2 denominator, coverage register, deployment conflict and acceptance contracts without authorizing implementation.
deliverables: docs/union-eyes/step2/UE_STEP2_MASTER_PLAN.md
docs/union-eyes/step2/UE_STEP2_WORK_BREAKDOWN.json
docs/union-eyes/step2/UE_STEP2_ACTION_AUTHORITY_MATRIX.json
docs/union-eyes/step2/UE_STEP2_DEPLOYMENT_AND_DATA_PLAN.md
docs/union-eyes/step2/UE_STEP2_ACCEPTANCE_REGISTER.json
docs/union-eyes/step2/UE_STEP2_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.md
docs/union-eyes/step2/UE_STEP2_EXECUTION_ORDER.md
packages.acceptance: The validator exits 0. STEP_2_PLANNING_COMPLETE may be YES. STEP_2_ENGINEERING_COMPLETE and STEP_2_ACCEPTED stay NO.

packages.title: Normal integration of PR 1309
packages.objective: Merge only after founder approval. The merge commit is a new source and does not inherit b00a362 check runs.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.01-INTEGRATE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: PR 1309 is merged by the normal path. The merge commit is recorded. No staging apply is implied.

packages.title: Exact-head qualification of the merge commit
packages.objective: Run the required GitHub checks on the merge commit before any image is treated as the candidate.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.01-REQUALIFY after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: The required workflows named in the execution order, on the merge SHA
packages.acceptance: Every required check on the merge SHA succeeded. Skipped main-only jobs are listed and are not counted as passes.

packages.title: Immutable application and scanner images
packages.objective: Build through .github/workflows/ue-v2-staging-build.yml and record registry digests.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.01-IMAGE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: Application, ClamAV adapter and cron image digests are attested to the merge SHA.

packages.title: Candidate source freeze
packages.objective: Rebind tooling/scripts/lib/ue-v2-staging-candidate.json from 6a60c95c to the merge SHA. Do not bind b00a362 while it is unmerged.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.01-BIND after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: git diff on the candidate pin and the typed projection
packages.acceptance: The candidate pin, typed projection and release manifest name the same merge SHA. SQL statement count does not change unless a reviewed plan regeneration says so.

packages.title: Read-only staging and database preimage
packages.objective: Resolve the serving-SHA conflict with a fresh revision, traffic, image and database observation. Capture PostgreSQL version, migration history, owners, ACLs, RLS attributes, sequences and row counts.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.02-PREIMAGE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: az containerapp revision list and a read-only catalog query. Neither command is run by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: A new evidence file names the command, time, revision, traffic weight, image digest and database catalog. Historical receipts are not reused as this observation.

packages.title: Released-topology applicability gate
packages.objective: Decide from the fresh preimage whether the four legacy installer cases must run before this transition.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.02-LEGACY-GATE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: The read-only function and event-trigger probe described in the deployment plan
packages.acceptance: If the preimage lacks current security topology, all four current-security-installer cases pass on authentic provenance before upgrade. If the preimage is already current topology, the four cases stay tracked and are not called passes. A current bootstrap is not substituted for a historical upgrade.

packages.title: Preserving upgrade rehearsal and rollback
packages.objective: Rehearse the data-preserving forward upgrade and a full transactional rollback on the staging preimage.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.02-REHEARSAL after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: Row counts, sequences, migration history and unrelated ACLs match the preimage after rollback. A failed historical rehearsal is not reused.

packages.title: Forward recovery after a committed upgrade
packages.objective: Prove the upgraded database starts the candidate and that recovery proceeds forward rather than by deleting data.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.02-FORWARD after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: The forward-upgrade workflow apply mode after a successful rehearsal
packages.acceptance: Original rows remain. Temporary privileges are gone. The candidate reaches its health check. No delete or truncate of business data is present in the evidence.

packages.title: No-delete infrastructure what-if
packages.objective: Run the staging deploy workflow in what-if mode and refuse deletes and drift.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.03-WHATIF after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: The what-if artifact has no deletes. The reviewed fingerprint matches the apply-time what-if.

packages.title: Zero-traffic candidate
packages.objective: Prepare the new revision at zero traffic while the current revision keeps 100 percent.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.03-ZERO-TRAFFIC after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: The new revision is healthy at 0 percent and the previously serving revision remains at 100 percent until promotion.

packages.title: Controlled traffic cutover and readback
packages.objective: Shift traffic only after health, then read back source, image and revision.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.03-CUTOVER after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: Serving revision, image digest and source SHA match the bound candidate. STAGING_GO remains HELD until S2.08.

packages.title: Deployed Entra sessions and MFA
packages.objective: Exercise real staging identity sessions, MFA and session revocation on the serving revision.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.04-ENTRA after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: A real session starts and a revoked session is refused. Synthetic QA cookies are not this proof.

packages.title: Membership, role change and multiple organizations
packages.objective: Prove active membership, role change, organization selection and departure.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.04-MEMBERSHIP after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: Deployed membership and organization journeys for the required families that own C05, C06 and C07
packages.acceptance: A role title without active membership is refused. A second organization does not inherit the first organization cases.

packages.title: Mandate, delegation, expiry, revocation and recusal
packages.objective: Prove resource authority that is separate from role title, including expiry and conflict.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.04-MANDATE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: Deployed mandate journeys for C07, C10 and C11
packages.acceptance: An expired, revoked, conflicted or missing mandate is refused. Office title does not replace the mandate.

packages.title: External and affiliated principal boundaries
packages.objective: Prove affiliated titles, employers, adverse parties and deferred counsel do not receive local case access.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.04-EXTERNAL after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: The denial rows in the action-authority matrix
packages.acceptance: Every denial row for SA15, SA16, SA18, SA19, SA22 and the deferred external families is evidenced. Deferred families are not passes.

packages.title: C01 through C04 on the serving revision
packages.objective: Qualify invitation, truthful provider status, reissue, revocation and organization-admin entry with negative cases.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-INVITE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: Deployed invitation journeys plus the provider receipt for C02
packages.acceptance: Positive and negative results, readback and audit are stored. A queued message without provider truth does not pass C02.

packages.title: C05 through C07 on the serving revision
packages.objective: Qualify organization setup, membership lifecycle and multiple capacity.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-ORG after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: Persisted organization, membership and active-organization selection survive reload. Cross-organization reads fail.

packages.title: C08 through C12 on the serving revision
packages.objective: Qualify intake, assignment, supervision, handoff and member follow-through, including closure.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-CASE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: An unassigned case is not visible to an executive title. Closure and handoff remove the prior actor access. Member follow-through stays on that member case.

packages.title: C09 automatic workload and expertise
packages.objective: Qualify the automatic assignment criterion separately from a manual assign.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-ASSIGN after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: The serving revision assigns from workload and expertise rules. A manual assign is not substituted.

packages.title: C13 through C15 on the serving revision
packages.objective: Qualify document journey, sealed export and OCR against private bytes.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-DOCS after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: Deployed document, export and OCR journeys
packages.acceptance: Bytes match the stored object. A sealed export refuses the wrong actor. OCR does not bypass document authority. Local shard 4 is not this proof.

packages.title: C16 and C17 on the serving revision
packages.objective: Qualify correspondence approval, dispatch and staff messaging.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-MAIL after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: A draft is not reported as dispatched. The member does not see internal notes. The other organization is refused.

packages.title: C18 and C19 on the serving revision
packages.objective: Qualify leadership indicators and organization administration without title bypass.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-LEAD after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: Indicators drill to a case only when the actor has that case authority. Admin audit operations read back the audit row.

packages.title: C20 privacy requests
packages.objective: Qualify a privacy request through decision, readback and audit.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-PRIVACY after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: The request persists. An unauthorized actor is refused. Completion is not reported when the write or audit fails.

packages.title: C21 connected deadlines
packages.objective: Qualify deadline creation, reminder and actor-specific visibility.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-DEADLINE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: Deployed deadline journey and the reminder worker
packages.acceptance: A deadline is visible only to an authorized actor. A missed worker run is reported as missed.

packages.title: C22 concurrency and recovery
packages.objective: Qualify conflict, retry, audit failure and recovery on the serving revision.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-RECOVERY after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: A failed audit is not returned as success. A retry does not create a second case. A conflict returns 409.

packages.title: Sensitive finance denial
packages.objective: Prove every required role is refused union finance and dues behavior.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.05-FINANCE after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: The deployed finance surface denies all 34 required roles. No financial transaction is created. Financial Officer 2.1 stays out of scope.

packages.title: O01 controlled inbox and provider state
packages.objective: Prove recipient delivery, deduplication, retry and dead letter with a controlled inbox.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.06-INBOX after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: A controlled-inbox run against the serving revision
packages.acceptance: Provider state is correlated to the audit row. A spoofed provider is refused. Absence of an inbox is an unexecuted proof.

packages.title: Workers, cron, retry and dead letter
packages.objective: Prove worker freshness and exactly-once handling for the required jobs.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.06-WORKERS after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: A stale worker is visible as stale. A retry does not double-apply. Dead letters are inspectable.

packages.title: O02 and O03 workload
packages.objective: Measure authenticated casework and the sustained pilot workload on the serving revision.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.07-PERF after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: The existing authenticated casework load harness pointed at the serving revision
packages.acceptance: Thresholds are the contract thresholds. A result from another SHA is not reused.

packages.title: Backup, audit seal, health, alerts and restore
packages.objective: Qualify O04, O05, O07, O08 and O15 from fresh operational evidence.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.07-OPS after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: Fresh backup, seal, health, alert and restore receipts
packages.acceptance: Each receipt names the serving revision. A missed backup or seal is not a pass.

packages.title: O11 accessibility and O12 bilingual states
packages.objective: Qualify accessibility and English/French states on the serving revision, including a narrow viewport.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.07-UX after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: O10 physical-device expansion stays deferred and is not counted. The Step 1 local browser matrix is not this proof.

packages.title: O13 registry truth and O14 telemetry
packages.objective: Qualify capability status and pilot telemetry against the serving revision.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.07-TRUTH after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: O13 and O14 on the serving revision
packages.acceptance: A route or navigation label is not a capability pass. Telemetry does not invent institutional adoption.

packages.title: Independent adversarial acceptance
packages.objective: Challenge security, privacy, authority, preservation and deployment integrity against the serving evidence.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.08-ADVERSARIAL after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
verificationCommands: A new adversarial record bound to the serving SHA
packages.acceptance: Every material finding is fixed or disposed. No finding is closed by a different SHA.

packages.title: Twenty staging criteria
packages.objective: Reconcile every required UE_STAGING_GO_CONTRACT criterion on the serving revision.
deliverables: Evidence cited by S2.08-CRITERIA after execution. None is produced by S2.00.
packages.acceptance: All 20 required criteria are PASS on the serving SHA. The advisory local-regression criterion is not one of the 20. This planning package does not mark them PASS.
